response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_diff FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS baseline FROM s) SELECT s.event_status AS status, s.avg_diff AS average, s.avg_diff - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL
